fold10_access: fold-10 access: pd.read_csv parsed ptbxl_database.csv once (all 21799 rows, all columns); of the 2198 fold-10 rows only the strat_fold value was used, to count them; immediately afterwards the frame was restricted to strat_fold <= 9 and the unrestricted frame was deleted. No fold-10 signal file was opened, no fold-10 tensor was built, and no other fold-10 value is held in any variable or used in any computation.
init_hash_recipe: sha256 over the state_dict entries in sorted(key) order; per entry: key.encode('utf-8') + b'\0' + str(t.dtype).encode('utf-8') + b'\0' + str(tuple(t.shape)).encode('utf-8') + b'\0' + t.detach().cpu().contiguous().numpy().tobytes() + b'\0', all fed to one hashlib.sha256 object; init_shared = keys starting with 'backbone.', 'pool.' or 'pool_norm.' (BN buffers included); init_full = all keys; computed after set_all_seeds(seed); ECGNet(arch, meta_dim) on CPU

schedule_preflight.procedure: CPU float64 dummy Parameter of 16 values (torch.randn, Generator seed 42); AdamW + OneCycleLR exactly as train_run (total_steps = EPOCHS * 154); each step: grad = zeros, lr read before opt.step(), prod *= 1 - wd*lr, opt.step(), sched.step()

warn_only_notes: Loss WARN is WARN-only: it has no consequence and is never a re-run criterion (the only re-run criterion is the locked one: a crash or a non-finite loss / parameters).

Zero-column rel_dev WARN is WARN-only: it has no consequence and is never a re-run criterion. Reason for the check: an all-zero training column gets zero gradient -> the Adam step is exactly 0 -> only AdamW's decoupled weight decay acts, so W_final should equal prod(1 - wd*lr) * W_init.
